case.need: Our office needs a way for staff to reserve shared meeting rooms and office vehicles. Staff should see when a resource is free and make repeating weekly reservations. Restricted rooms need a supervisor's approval. We also need to see how much each location's resources are used. No public access, event registration, or visitor management is needed. Existing staff accounts will be used; OIT can perform normal setup.
case.expected: An eligible standalone resource-booking asset can satisfy the entire need; a single asset-kind suggestion should be visible without a fabricated service, integration chain or extra feature.

content.title: Shared Meeting Room and Vehicle Reservation System
content.problem: Staff need to see when meeting rooms and office vehicles are free and make recurring weekly reservations. Restricted rooms require supervisor approval and management wants usage visibility by location.
unknowns: Whether reservation changes or cancellations need automated notifications to staff.
Number of office locations that need separate utilization reporting.
constraints: No public access to the reservation system is needed.
No event registration functionality is needed.
No visitor management functionality is needed.
OIT will perform normal account setup; no special provisioning requested.
requirements: Allow staff to book shared meeting rooms and office vehicles against availability.
Route restricted room bookings to a supervisor for approval.
Provide utilization reporting broken down by location.
Use existing staff accounts for sign-in.
content.affectedPeople: Office staff booking rooms and vehicles; supervisors approving restricted room requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Staff can view real-time availability of shared rooms and vehicles.
Staff can create recurring weekly reservations.
Restricted room bookings are routed to a supervisor for approval before confirmation.
Managers can view resource usage/utilization by location.

questions: Which specific rooms or vehicles require supervisor approval, and who are the approving supervisors?
How should usage reports be reviewed—by whom and how often?

requesterSuggestion.summary: Facility Scheduler lets staff check availability and book shared meeting rooms and vehicles, including recurring weekly reservations, with supervisor approval for restricted rooms and usage reports per location.
conditions: OIT will connect it to existing staff accounts during standard setup.
OIT will confirm which rooms are restricted and who approves them during configuration.
